name: Paper Locust Tornado OLD
description: A book unfurls and its case forms into a leathery locust, its pages folding into an overwhelming swarm.
disable: DC 23 Thievery to tear up the leather locust, or DC 21 Arcana (trained) or Dispel Magic (3nd rank; counteract DC 25) to render the magic inert.
reset: The paper locust tornado resets after 1 minute if there are no creatures to target.
routine:
(2 actions) The tornado uses each action to move up to 30 feet and share a creature's space, slicing into them with their paper wings and spurs. The targeted creatures must attempt a DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes (2d8+9) Slashing Damage damage.

Failure The creature takes 2d8 Slashing Damage damage and 1d10 Persistent,bleed Damage damage.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is Clumsy 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fold Swarm
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the bookshelf

Effect The enchanted book transforms into a tornado of origami locusts and one leather locust. The trap then rolls initiative.
